scope.baseline: Two separate fresh dataflow questions in one running installed Python process. Compared with the existing analyze_together API in the same installed client and interpreter. Both find both functions before analysis; no saved setup or whole-answer store.
scope.bytes: report_json_bytes counts compact UTF-8 JSON reserialized from each parsed native report, including both find reports. It is not raw pipe traffic, agent-visible text or a memory measurement.
scope.claims: Four disclosed development examples, five repetitions, both orders, edits, unknown startup and exhausted work. Python behavior is checked separately, outside timed sequences. No unfamiliar-library acceptance, general language runtime overhead, memory savings or agent-task speedup claim.
scope.cost: One process start through parsed ready, seven submitted pairs through parsed replies, and stop through process exit. Includes imports, both function lookups, initially empty project-cache fill, native processes, analysis, SDK validation, instrumentation, report serialization and reply parsing. Controller fixture edits, evidence persistence and receipt checks are outside those intervals but included in session wall time.
scope.installation: Wheel build, installation without dependencies and checked-hash bytecode compilation are recorded separately. Same verified source in both conditions. Does not include provisioning the runner, interpreter or build dependencies, or compiling fr.
scope.limits: Each separate question receives 4096 steps (1 in the exhausted case) and 1048576 response bytes. The combined request shares that same cap between both answers, not twice the cap. Depth 8, html context, summaries enabled, imports explicit per case. Timings are comparable as equal-answer work only when answers actually agree.
